name: The Song of Invermere
source:
A gothic romantic horror visual novel told from the perspective of a servant of the cloth.

Play as the Lamb: wanderer, outsider, and sister of the Red Church. Serve the parish in a time of when nightmares walk and uncover the dark secrets that shackle the town.

[Edited from [url=https://9sen.itch.io/the-song-of-invermere]itch.io[/url]]
